fixed_rules.J: PIT top10 own-close SMA trend; independent long/CASH states; inverse-vol size at portfolio vol target, max25pct per asset with unused cash; daily causal trend-loss exit; no holding cap; no averaging down; no correlation filter
fixed_rules.K: top10 lagged 30d quote-volume PIT universe with 365 observed days and >=10m USD/day; positive own trend; inverse-vol weights; max5 positions; greedy descending liquidity correlation filter over 90 prior daily returns; no renormalization of rejected weights; 2pct weight deadband and 10pct rank hysteresis
fixed_rules.L: BTC market SMA AND PIT breadth plus BTC realized vol20 <=1.2*prior63d median vol; breadth off=on-0.1 with 2day confirmation; inverse-vol positive momentum positions capped25pct; adverse regime scales targets, never earned returns; derivative features excluded
fixed_rules.M: three equal fixed 1/3 sleeves: own SMA slow, close breakout with 20day low exit, positive momentum; same PIT universe; total account vol20 target; max25pct per asset; weekly rebalance; no choosing best sleeve
fixed_rules.N: prior-bar Donchian high breakout; per-asset initial and trailing stops frozen at signal using ATR; high-water mark only advances after bar; new asset resets all stop state; no averaging down; no partial take profit; nominal, no-trailing, no-initial-stop, no-stop ablations all preregistered
fixed_rules.exposure_breach: retain actual breach and PnL, cancel entries, request next-realizable reduction; any >1.0 breach invalidates nomination, never clip reported exposure
fixed_rules.execution: daily UTC signal available next midnight+60s; first actual 1h bar strictly later; participation<=0.1pct prior hour quote volume; entry TTL6h exit TTL18h; mark residual until truly filled; missing price/funding/rules invalidates certified track
fixed_rules.intrabar_stop: long gap stop fills at worse of bar open/stop minus slippage; if high and low both touched assume adverse order; never use current-bar high to improve a same-bar trailing fill; actual liquidity partial-fill cap; unfilled residual retains losses and adverse mark
fixed_rules.funding: actual timestamped signed venue rates; missing is unknown, not zero; adverse stress max(2*debit,10bps_per_day) without multiplying credits
fixed_rules.state: per-asset CASH, PENDING_ENTRY, LONG, PENDING_EXIT, COOLDOWN; exits prior to new entries; cooldown7d after failed breakout; no transfer of PnL/high-water/cooldown across assets

windows.unbounded_hold_rule: 244 is feature lookback240+publication1+exit3, NOT a bound on episode dependence; additionally purge whole episodes intersecting boundaries, start each scored book flat after unscored warmup, censor unresolved training episodes, never transfer label-derived state; require executable event-overlap regression before implementation_ready
windows.nonoverlap: scored outer years2023/2026 disjoint; 2024-2025 never evaluated by new strategies or supplied to selection/proposals; 2026 origin inner selection is deliberately capped at2023-12-31
windows.accounting: separate causally initialized annual exploratory books; no fictional continuous equity over missing2024-2025; aggregate disjoint-fold metrics explicitly labeled; episode attribution stays within actual book; bootstrap blocks never cross the gap

deepseek.output: exact family-specific parameter object, parent_id, hypothesis<=600chars; additionalProperties=false; reject inactive keys, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, out-of-range values and normalized duplicate IDs before evaluation; no arbitrary code/tools
deepseek.matched_control: same seeds, initial populations, four slots per generation, same evaluation budget; rejected/uncertain calls count and deterministic replacement uses same reserved slot
deepseek.api_reservation: reserve worst_case_tokens_and_dollars_before_network; no_retry_uncertain_calls; record_exact_payload_response_usage_price_version; broker cannot read forward database

forward.selection: preselect at most2 per family from inner validity/risk/Pareto; freeze before exploratory outer; outer/stresses may only reject these, never replace/rerank them; MDD<=25pct Sharpe>=1.5 Calmar>=4 plus all robustness; deterministic rules_hash tie break; missing evidence yields no nomination
forward.first_day: UTC date strictly after actual freeze; never backfill

collector.universe_metadata: all native perp assets; detailed bars/books fixed10_collection_assets_not_PIT_strategy_universe
